idea-plugin.name: SQLAlchemy Model Generator
idea-plugin.description:
Generate SQLAlchemy 2.0 ORM models from existing MySQL / PostgreSQL database tables.

Features:

  • Batch generate Mapped[T] + mapped_column() style model code
  • Multi-table selection with single-file or multi-file output modes
  • Auto-inferred relationships from foreign keys
  • Customizable Jinja2 code templates

Compatible with IntelliJ IDEA Community / Ultimate and PyCharm Community / Professional.

action.description: Generate SQLAlchemy 2.0 ORM models from database tables
